items.title: Adobe appoints new CEO to succeed Narayen in December
items.summary: Adobe (ADBE) executive Anil Chakravarthy has been chosen to succeed CEO Shantanu Narayen, starting in his chief executive role this December with Narayen becoming executive chair. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and Interactive Brokers Chief Strategist Steve Sosnick to discuss the details of Adobe's succession plans.

items.title: What Pays Adobe Stock Owners While The Freemium Bet Waits
items.summary: Adobe (ADBE) has lost 18% over the past twelve months while the S&P 500 returned 21%. The underlying driver is strategic: Adobe is intentionally directing more top-of-funnel users toward freemium experiences rather than upfront paywalls, and it is managing that transition alongside leadership changes, with an interim CFO in place and Anil Chakravarthy set to succeed Shantanu Narayen as CEO on December 1, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Sinks 7% as Internal CEO Pick Lands Ahead of Earnings, Workday Falls 4%
items.summary: Adobe named an internal successor days before a scheduled earnings report, and investors are not treating the timing as a coincidence. The question hanging over the stock is whether the new CEO can answer what the AI era actually means for the company's core business.
